infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MotiveLife uses the microphone for Voice Organize — speak your thoughts and get plans, goals, and tasks.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MotiveLife uses the camera so you can take a profile photo for your Life Circle.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MotiveLife needs photo library access so you can choose a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MotiveLife may save photos you choose for your profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MotiveLife uses your location for MyMotiveFamily — so your household can see where you are when you choose to share.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MotiveLife needs Always location so MyMotiveFamily can keep sharing your live position with your household when the app is in the background — like a family safety map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: MotiveLife needs Always location so MyMotiveFamily can keep sharing your live position with your household when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: MotiveLife reads steps, sleep, heart rate, and workouts from Apple Health to power your Life Brief and coaching insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: MotiveLife may save wellness insights you choose to write back to Apple Health.
